name: Moraliste ~Seikatsu Shidou Fusae no Houkago~
original_name: モラリスト ～性渇指導 房江の放課後～
source:
Aoba Private Academy is located on a slightly elevated hill surrounded by a quiet residential area lined with mansions. It is a private school with a prestigious reputation where many daughters and sons of good families attend.

The school's culture is based on the school motto, “Friendship, Diligence, and Innocence,” and the school's long-established school rules are highly respected.

Fusae Fujishima, a graduate of this school, was assigned as a Japanese language teacher a few years ago. She is serious and strict, and was in charge of the life guidance advisor. She was considered a hard-headed and inflexible teacher, and was looked down upon by the students.

--One day after school--

After homeroom was over, Fusae was patrolling an empty hallway as usual, Fusae discovers a female student sneaking around and acting suspiciously.

Fusae followed her, and what she saw was...

It was an image of her husband, Yoshio, and his student, Yoshimi, locking lips in an empty, somewhat dimly lit classroom. She has been married for three years to Yoshio, a teacher at the same school.

Fusae thought things were going well with her husband, even though they were not even having a physical intimate.


From then on... Fusae started to change little by little...

With the collapse of morals, a short ADV depicting a female teacher who is mad with jealousy and indulgent in pleasure.

[From [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
私立青叶学园坐落在一座稍高的山丘上，周围环绕着豪宅林立的安静住宅区。这是一所享有盛誉的私立学校，许多名门望族的儿女就读。

学校的文化以校训“友谊、勤奋、纯真”为基础，学校长期制定的校规受到高度尊重。

该校的毕业生藤岛房江几年前被任命为日语教师。她认真严格，担任生活指导顾问。她被认为是一位顽固、不灵活的老师，并被学生们瞧不起。

——放学后的一天——

下课后，房江像往常一样在空荡荡的走廊里巡逻，房江发现一名女学生鬼鬼祟祟、举止可疑。

房惠跟在她身后，看到的却是……

照片中，她的丈夫吉雄和他的学生吉美在一间空荡荡的、灯光有些昏暗的教室里唇齿相依。她与同一所学校的老师吉雄结婚三年了。

房江认为她和丈夫的关系很顺利，尽管他们甚至没有亲密的身体接触。


从此……房江开始一点一点地改变……

道德沦丧，一段描写嫉妒疯狂、纵欲享乐的女教师的ADV短片。
